environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on Apache Tomcat 9.0.50 embedded server, running in a Docker container (ubuntu:22.04 base) on ECS Fargate. No reverse proxy or WAF in front. Direct ALB passthrough with target group routing TCP traffic on port 8080. Container runs with default Docker capabilities. Spring Boot property `server.tomcat.reject-illegal-header` is not set (defaults to false in this version).
